itinerary.title: Day 1 — Hanoi
description: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arriving at Noi Bai International Airport on your early morning flight (arrivals at 5:00 AM and 7:30 AM), our private host will greet you at the boarding gate with VIP Airport Fast-track service to expedite immigration. Transfer by private air-conditioned vehicle to Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa, where early check-in has been...
activities: VIP Airport Fast-track, private airport transfer, pre-arranged hotel early check-in, gourmet Indian vegetarian welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 2 — Ninh Binh
description: Embark on a full-day private excursion to Ninh Binh. Experience the serene beauty of Trang An landscape complex, a UNESCO World Heritage site, during a traditional rowboat tour through limestone caves. Visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu and climb to the peak of Mua Cave for panoramic views over the rice fields. Savor a local vegetarian lunch...
activities: Private roundtrip vehicle to Ninh Binh, English guide, Trang An boat tour, Mua Cave entry, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 3 — Halong Bay
description: Depart Hanoi by private vehicle to Halong Bay. Board the premium Ambassador Signature Cruise, where your Double and Triple cabins await. Glide past iconic karst formations and enjoy a delicious vegetarian buffet lunch on board. Participate in cruise activities including a bamboo boat ride, kayaking, or climbing for scenic viewpoints. Savor a...
activities: Private transfer Hanoi - Halong, double & triple cabins on Ambassador Signature Cruise, cruise excursions, onboard vegetarian lunch and...

itinerary.title: Day 4 — Hanoi / Sapa
description: Greet the sunrise with Tai Chi on the sundeck. After a vegetarian brunch, check out and transfer back to Hanoi. Enjoy a private half-day city tour of Hanoi, visiting the historic Temple of Literature and Hoan Kiem Lake. Enjoy some free time for shopping. In the evening, savor a vegetarian dinner in Hanoi before boarding the Chapa Express Train to...
activities: Onboard vegetarian brunch, private transfer Halong - Hanoi, Hanoi half-day tour with guide and entry tickets, private vegetarian dinner,...

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Sapa
description: Arrive at Lao Cai station early in the morning and transfer to Sapa town. Check in to Aliana Boutique Sapa Hotel And Spa and enjoy a hot breakfast. Embark on a guided trekking tour to Cat Cat village, learning about the Black Hmong culture and viewing the scenic waterfall. Savor a local vegetarian lunch. Spend a relaxed afternoon exploring Sapa...
activities: Station transfer, Sapa tour with guide and entry tickets, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 6 — Sapa
description: A highlights day in Sapa! Take the Fansipan cable car, the longest three-rope cable car system in the world, to ascend the 'Roof of Indochina' at 3,143 meters. Explore the spiritual pagoda complex at the summit. Enjoy a scenic vegetarian lunch. In the afternoon, visit Ta Van village or shop for souvenirs in Sapa town. Overnight at Aliana Boutique...
activities: Fansipan cable car roundtrip tickets, guide, Sapa transfers, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 7 — Hanoi
description: Enjoy a leisurely morning in Sapa for final sightseeing or shopping. In the afternoon, board your private luxury vehicle for the scenic drive back to Hanoi (approx. 5 hours). Arrive directly at Noi Bai International Airport for your late-evening international departure flight.
activities: Private luxury transfer Sapa - Hanoi Airport.

hotels.name: Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa
hotels.introduction: Nestled in the historic Ba Dinh district, Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa blends French colonial charm with modern hospitality. It offers elegant rooms, a rooftop bar with spectacular city views, and a serene spa for a perfect urban retreat.

hotels.name: Ambassador Signature Cruise
hotels.introduction: A premier 5-star overnight cruise sailing through the mystical waters of Halong Bay and Lan Ha Bay. The cruise features elegant cabins with private balconies, upscale dining, an outdoor jacuzzi, and immersive itineraries showcasing natural wonders.

hotels.name: Chapa Express Train
hotels.introduction: Chapa Express Train offers premium overnight sleeper service between Hanoi and Lao Cai (Sapa). Featuring traditional wooden panels, comfortable air-conditioned cabins, clean amenities, and personalized passenger hospitality.

hotels.name: Aliana Boutique Sapa Hotel And Spa
hotels.introduction: Located in the scenic mist-covered hills of Sapa, Aliana Boutique Sapa Hotel And Spa features stunning panoramic views of Fansipan mountain and Muong Hoa valley. Designed with local heritage details, the hotel offers comfortable heated rooms, an outdoor pool, and local gourmet dining.

room_notes: Double + Triple room configurations pre-arranged across all properties. For the overnight train, 2 private 4-berth cabins have been fully booked for 5 guests to ensure complete comfort.

whyWorks.privateFlexible: Travel in complete exclusivity with your private air-conditioned vehicle and dedicated English-speaking guide. The daily pacing is highly flexible, ensuring your group can explore Hanoi, Ninh Binh, Sapa, and Halong Bay comfortably at your own speed.
whyWorks.comfort: Enjoy premium accommodations including Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa, Ambassador Signature Cruise in Halong, and Aliana Boutique Sapa. For the overnight train journey to Sapa, we have pre-arranged 2 private 4-berth cabins on the Chapa Express Train to guarantee absolute privacy and space for your group of 5.
whyWorks.muslimFriendly: Your dietary requirements are fully respected. All included meals feature carefully curated Indian vegetarian selections, with eggs permitted and strictly no meat, fish, or seafood. Restaurants and cruise chefs are briefed to prevent cross-contamination.
whyWorks.balancedHighlights: A perfect harmony of historic culture in Hanoi, scenic rivers in Ninh Binh, a luxury overnight cruise in Halong Bay, and highland exploration in Sapa, offering a complete northern Vietnam experience in 7 days.

itinerary.summary: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arriving at Noi Bai International Airport on your early morning flight (arrivals at 5:00 AM and 7:30 AM), our private host will greet you at the boarding gate with VIP Airport Fast-track service to expedite immigration. Transfer by private air-conditioned vehicle to Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa, where early check-in has been pre-arranged so you can rest immediately. In the evening, gather for a welcome Indian vegetarian dinner.
itinerary.mainInclusions: VIP Airport Fast-track, private airport transfer, pre-arranged hotel early check-in, gourmet Indian vegetarian welcome dinner.

itinerary.summary: Embark on a full-day private excursion to Ninh Binh. Experience the serene beauty of Trang An landscape complex, a UNESCO World Heritage site, during a traditional rowboat tour through limestone caves. Visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu and climb to the peak of Mua Cave for panoramic views over the rice fields. Savor a local vegetarian lunch (eggs allowed, no fish/meat). Return to Hanoi for your overnight stay.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private roundtrip vehicle to Ninh Binh, English guide, Trang An boat tour, Mua Cave entry, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.summary: Depart Hanoi by private vehicle to Halong Bay. Board the premium Ambassador Signature Cruise, where your Double and Triple cabins await. Glide past iconic karst formations and enjoy a delicious vegetarian buffet lunch on board. Participate in cruise activities including a bamboo boat ride, kayaking, or climbing for scenic viewpoints. Savor a premium vegetarian set-dinner on board under the stars.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer Hanoi - Halong, double & triple cabins on Ambassador Signature Cruise, cruise excursions, onboard vegetarian lunch and dinner.

itinerary.summary: Greet the sunrise with Tai Chi on the sundeck. After a vegetarian brunch, check out and transfer back to Hanoi. Enjoy a private half-day city tour of Hanoi, visiting the historic Temple of Literature and Hoan Kiem Lake. Enjoy some free time for shopping. In the evening, savor a vegetarian dinner in Hanoi before boarding the Chapa Express Train to Sapa, where you will stay in 2 private 4-berth cabins for complete comfort.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Onboard vegetarian brunch, private transfer Halong - Hanoi, Hanoi half-day tour with guide and entry tickets, private vegetarian dinner, Chapa Express Train tickets.

itinerary.summary: Arrive at Lao Cai station early in the morning and transfer to Sapa town. Check in to Aliana Boutique Sapa Hotel And Spa and enjoy a hot breakfast. Embark on a guided trekking tour to Cat Cat village, learning about the Black Hmong culture and viewing the scenic waterfall. Savor a local vegetarian lunch. Spend a relaxed afternoon exploring Sapa town at leisure.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Station transfer, Sapa tour with guide and entry tickets, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.summary: A highlights day in Sapa! Take the Fansipan cable car, the longest three-rope cable car system in the world, to ascend the 'Roof of Indochina' at 3,143 meters. Explore the spiritual pagoda complex at the summit. Enjoy a scenic vegetarian lunch. In the afternoon, visit Ta Van village or shop for souvenirs in Sapa town. Overnight at Aliana Boutique Sapa.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Fansipan cable car roundtrip tickets, guide, Sapa transfers, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.summary: Enjoy a leisurely morning in Sapa for final sightseeing or shopping. In the afternoon, board your private luxury vehicle for the scenic drive back to Hanoi (approx. 5 hours). Arrive directly at Noi Bai International Airport for your late-evening international departure flight.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private luxury transfer Sapa - Hanoi Airport.

inclusions: Premium accommodation in Hanoi (Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa) and Sapa (Aliana Boutique Sapa) with early check-in pre-arranged on Day 1.
Overnight luxury cruise on Ambassador Signature Cruise in Halong Bay with all onboard meals included.
Overnight sleeper train tickets on Chapa Express Train in 2 private 4-berth cabins for comfort and privacy.
Private VIP fast-track immigration handling and airport transfers upon arrival in Hanoi.
All ground transfers in private air-conditioned vehicles as detailed in the itinerary.
Private English-speaking guides for all sightseeing tours and excursions.
All entrance fees, boat tickets, and activity charges (including Fansipan cable car tickets).
Vietnam E-visas processing and fees included for all 5 guests.
Dedicated Indian vegetarian meals (Lacto-Ovo: eggs allowed, strictly no meat, fish, or seafood) pre-arranged at all stops.
exclusions: International flights to and from Vietnam.
Personal expenses (laundry, beverages, telephone calls, etc.).
Tips and gratuities for guides and drivers.
